ModelVariations.Description: All-new, wider Meridian 341 Sedan introduced for 2005.

ModelCharacter: Meridian's entry-level bridge cruiser, but really two distinct boats under one model number. The 2003–04 version is essentially the Bayliner 3488 Command Bridge rebadged as Meridian; the 2005–14 generation is a completely new, wider two-stateroom yacht with far more interior volume and almost no conventional side decks.
DesignLineage: The first Meridian 341 (2003–04) directly continues the Bayliner 3488 Command Bridge hull, accommodations and flybridge layout.
An all-new 341 Sedan arrived for 2005 with greater beam, new styling, revised two-stateroom interior and different hull geometry.
The 2003–04 and 2005–14 boats therefore share a marketed model number, not a common hull.
Both generations fit Meridian's core formula of affordable flybridge living space, twin inboards and easy molded-stair bridge access.
OwnershipCharacter: The later 341 is extremely roomy for its nominal size but achieves that volume by minimizing side decks and carrying considerable machinery/system density. Twin gas inboards are common; diesel examples exist. Thrusters, bridge systems, generator, HVAC and tight access make it more complex than a simple sedan of similar length.
